reason: Google stopped crawling us. 5,036 URLs sit in 'Discovered - currently not indexed' and the queue grows every day. Measured 2026-08-27: the 634 posts published since 08-08 have produced 0 impressions and 0 clicks, while posts from July still earn. We were paying Places/vision/translation costs for pages Google never fetched. Cutting intake from ~330 URLs/day to 25 so the queue can drain.

restoreTo.note: backfill 'ramp' is the original 25/35/50-by-week logic in backfill.yml; setting backfillPerRun to any number overrides it, and -1 restores the ramp. Restore ONLY under the queue-fell branch below - never as a reflex.

howToDecide: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-28 (owner delegated; supersedes the older text that said 'restore the values above' when the queue had not moved - the 08-28 five-analyst audit + Codex cross-exam judged that reflex wrong). On revisitAt, FIRST export GSC coverage and crawl stats segmented by language, page type, publication cohort and host (the falsification test for the site-classification hypothesis). THEN: (a) if 'Discovered - currently not indexed' fell meaningfully below 5,036, intake was a binding constraint - raise postsPerRun slowly (5 -> 10 -> 16 over weeks), re-measuring each step; (b) if it has NOT moved, do NOT restore volume - hold 5/day, keep the freed Places/vision/translation budget on refresh + authority work (backlinks, template-variance cohort), and re-read on the next cycle. A red verdict means the constraint is authority and uniformity, and more URLs make that worse, not better.

ownerDecisions.translations: 2026-08-28 owner decision: ALL FIVE LANGUAGES stay for every post, unconditionally. Translation gating (EN-first, others after indexation) was proposed by the audit and REJECTED by the owner - do not resurrect it as an optimization.
